Thanks for setting up this thread! Hopefully it'll allow for more signal on the Schiit Happened one.

Headphones get the most time with me because my basement is cool and dark, and I like warm and bright. The headphone stack is upstairs in my SW-facing reading room with big windows. Listening will flip in in the Winter months to the basement 2.1 system when it's dark more than light.

Headphone stack. The Gremlin will likely go soon because using the Mjolnir 3 as a preamp to is is overkill, and the Mjolnir move to this stack was very recent. It gets all the joy at the moment. Recently pulled from this stack was a Sys, Magni Piety (both in storage now), and Asgard X. The AX was swapped with the M3 in the 2.1 setup:

I have to re-do the basement home theatre/2.1 diagram, but the core components are Gungnir 2, Freya N, Lokius, Asgard X, Denon X4500H, Vintage Tascam CD player, M1 Mac Mini, and other bits and pieces.

The upstairs office has a 3rd-party R2R DAC, Asgard 3, Loki Mini +, and an Eitr 2 F and a pair of Fluance powered speakers.

A Vestri gets taken to and used in various places.
